skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and analyze the dynamics of real estate markets, supply and demand, and their impact on real estate prices.
Analyze trends in supply, demand, and real estate prices.
Analyze the balance of supply and demand and the formation of real estate prices.
Understand and analyze government policies and management tools for real estate markets.
Develop critical thinking skills to analyze real estate market scenarios.
Develop collaboration skills through group work and presentations.
Understand and apply professional ethics in real estate market analysis.
Develop independent work skills and responsibility in real estate market analysis.
Develop skills in presenting and defending personal viewpoints based on objective and scientific approaches.
